events.name: Christmas Princess Carriage
events.description: Your pet steps out of a glowing crystal carriage on a snowy Christmas night, in a crown and a red satin gown, stands up in little red heels, twirls and poses.

events.name: Santa Nice List
events.description: Santa checks his Naughty & Nice list in his candle-lit workshop, gold sparkles swirl, and the person on the nice list appears in an ornate gold frame under pine garland and red bows.

events.name: Self Hug Sketch
events.description: You lean back against a plain grey wall in full colour while a giant black-and-white pencil drawing of you, sketched on the wall behind you, wraps its arms around you, with "Embrace of my own self" handwritten beside you.

events.name: Steer Wrestling
events.description: You burst out of the rodeo box on a dark horse, lean out over a running steer, slide off onto its horns and twist it down in the dust, all in slow motion.

events.name: Tidal Wave
events.description: Three friends pose with their backs to a seafront railing on a stormy night, a giant wave rises behind them and crashes down over all three, and two of them get up and wade out of the foam straight toward the phone.
